//: What each suite must reach on each host, read by .github/scripts/test-guard.mjs in CI (tests.yml) and in the pre-push hook. Raise a floor when tests are added; lowering one is a decision to write down in the commit that does it. Linux skips only the tests that drive a real Windows PowerShell; a Windows host compiles dot-agentd's unix-only test files out and skips the two Go tests that need a Linux guest.

linux.allow_skipped: ^generated PowerShell on a real Windows PowerShell
